title: Fault-Path Theorem
description: Extends BT1603 from finite universal ABI to finite retry/failure ABI by tracking missed clicks, dark clicks, Hesse/T injection failure, and Pauli-frame recovery.

fault_taxonomy.description: Photon injected but no Fano bin fired
Bin fired with no real photon present
Pauli-frame correction could not be applied; frame aborted

retry_schedule.description: Per-fault retry budget; overridable per bench run

frame_lifecycle: on fault: record FaultEvent, check retry budget
on CSS syndrome: apply Pauli correction, mark CORRECTED
on hard fault or budget exhausted: mark ABORTED
